GLugo Circuit Mapper — Board Loader

Loads the software onto each ESP32-C3 board and sets its number. Firmware v2.5.

This page needs Google Chrome (or Microsoft Edge) on your Mac. Open this file in Chrome.
This board will be
Radio power
Use the same setting on the hub and all units. Start with Medium.
Details

  


  

    
How to use

    
    
      
  1. Plug one board into your Mac with a USB-C data cable.
    2. 
      
  2. Pick Unit and its number, Hub for the main battery board, or Repeater (number 1) for the second battery board at the far end of the house. Then tap Load board.
    3. 
      
  3. In the pop-up, pick the port that says USB JTAG/serial debug unit and tap Connect.
    4. 
      
  4. If it won't connect or the port keeps blinking in the list: hold BOOT, tap RST, let go of BOOT, then try again.
    5. 
      
  5. Wait about 30 seconds. When it says Done, press RST once so it starts, then unplug it and stick the label on. The number moves up by one for the next board.
    6. 
      
  6. After Done, if the blue light doesn't blip, press RST once (or unplug and replug).
    7. 
    

  

  

    
On the job

    
    
      
  1. Plug the hub into the drill-battery USB port. Its blue light stays on.
    2. 
      
  2. Plug the units into the outlets. Their blue light blips every 2 seconds.
    3. 
      
  3. On your iPhone, join WiFi GLugo-Mapper (password glugo1234), then open 192.168.4.1 in Safari.
    4.
